<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—peaks spaced by ~1.003 Da with intensities decreasing roughly by an order of magnitude—the pattern matches the 13C isotopic distribution of carbon in a molecule containing many carbon atoms. No other element shows such a clear, sequential 1 Da spacing with this intensity profile, so only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
